notes.title: Update 0.06
notes.content:
Latest Development News of Our Game!

As our destruction game continues to evolve, we are excited to share with you the progress made in its development. Although the game is not yet available, here is an overview of the significant advances we have worked on:

First Steps with Sound Effects (SFX): We have begun to integrate the first sound effects, bringing a new dimension of immersion to the game. These sound effects are designed to enrich every action and interaction, making the experience even more vivid.

Continuous Lighting Improvement: The lighting for existing levels has been further improved, refining the visual atmosphere and highlighting the mechanisms of destruction in a more striking manner.

Creation of New Levels: We have added new levels to the game, offering unprecedented challenges and opportunities for creative destruction. These levels are designed to test and stimulate your ingenuity.

Innovation with a Fluid Physics System: The development of an advanced system to simulate fluid physics has begun.

These developments mark important milestones in the creation of our game, reflecting our commitment to offering a rich and diversified gaming experience. We are looking forward to sharing with you the fruits of our labor and seeing how these innovations will enrich the overall experience.

Your interest and support for our project are incredibly motivating. Although you cannot dive into the game yet, we are keen to share our progress and look forward to your feedback.

Stay connected for more updates on our development adventure!
